extension.description: Generate validated Markdown section updates with Codex CLI and apply them through VS Code.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: Codex Note Helper runs an external Codex CLI process and applies generated edits, so it is disabled in untrusted workspaces.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: Codex Note Helper requires a file-backed Markdown document on a local or remote extension host and an executable Codex CLI.

configuration.title: Codex Note Helper
configuration.mode.description: Controls the generation profile used for target headings.
configuration.mode.enum.research: Generate concise research notes with a paper reference when it can be verified.
configuration.mode.enum.general: Generate concise explanatory notes without requiring references.
configuration.mode.enum.jobHunting: Generate company, role-fit, selection, and interview notes.
configuration.fillPolicy.description: Selects which sections at the configured heading level are eligible for an update.
configuration.fillPolicy.enum.emptyOnly: Update only sections with no meaningful body content.
configuration.fillPolicy.enum.emptyOrBul: Update empty sections and sections containing only Markdown list source notes.
configuration.fillPolicy.enum.appendAlwa: Update every matching heading. Existing content is preserved; generated content is replaced or appended using managed markers.
configuration.researchField.description: Optional research-field context supplied to Codex, for example `quantum computing`.
configuration.outputLanguage.description: Language name to request for generated note text, for example `Japanese` or `English`.
configuration.noteStyle.description: Optional style instruction supplied to Codex. Leave empty to use the selected mode's safe default.
configuration.headingLevel.description: Exact Markdown heading level treated as note titles. ATX H1–H6 and Setext H1–H2 are supported. Headings inside code blocks are ignored, and a section ends at the next heading of the same or a higher level.
configuration.headingLevel.enum.h1: Top-level ATX (`#`) or Setext (`=` underline) headings.
configuration.headingLevel.enum.h2: Second-level ATX (`##`) or Setext (`-` underline) headings.
configuration.codexCommand.description: Machine-scoped Codex CLI executable name or absolute path. Do not include command-line arguments. The resolved real executable must be outside open workspace roots and requires fingerprint approval before probing or generation.
configuration.allowBundledCodexFromOpenA: When `codexNoteHelper.codexCommand` is the default `codex`, allow fallback to a compatible executable bundled with the OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex extension only if `codex` is absent from `PATH`. `PATH` is always checked first.
configuration.enableWebSearch.descriptio: Allow Codex web search for source verification. This adds network activity, is disabled by default, and requires confirmation on every enabled run.
configuration.showCodexProgress.descript: Show throttled, fixed-stage progress notifications. Raw commands, paths, prompts, and generated note text are not displayed.
configuration.timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum Codex runtime in seconds. A timeout cancels the proposal before any editor changes are applied.
configuration.maxTargetHeadings.descript: Maximum number of target headings allowed in one run. Larger batches are refused before Codex starts.
configuration.maxInputCharacters.descrip: Maximum active-document size in characters accepted for one run. Larger documents are refused before Codex starts.
configuration.maxOutputBytes.description: Maximum captured Codex output in bytes. Exceeding the limit cancels and discards the proposal before applying edits.
configuration.confirmBeforeRun.descripti: Controls the target-summary confirmation shown before Codex starts. First-run data consent is always required. Runs with web search or Codex user configuration enabled are always confirmed.
configuration.confirmBeforeRun.enum.alwa: Confirm the file, target count, mode, policy, and network setting before every run.
configuration.confirmBeforeRun.enum.appe: Confirm only when the `appendAlways` target policy is active.
configuration.confirmBeforeRun.enum.neve: Do not show routine confirmations after first-run consent. Web search and Codex user configuration still require confirmation on every run.
configuration.ignoreCodexUserConfigurati: Run with `--ignore-user-config` for predictable behavior while retaining the current Codex authentication. The extension always uses ephemeral mode and ignores repository rule files. Disabling this setting requires confirmation on every run.
